versions.content: Service name: Com_Init Syntax: void Com_Init( const Com_ConfigType* config ) Service ID[hex]: 0x01 Sync/Async: Synchronous Reentrancy: Non Reentrant Parameters (in): config Pointer to the AUTOSAR COM module's configuration data. Parameters (i n- out): None Parameters (out): None Return value: None Description: This service initializes internal and external interfaces and variables of the AUTOSAR COM module layer for the further processing. After calling this function the inter - ECU communication is still disabled. Available via: Com.h
